title: Appeal chain
description: Array of docket → judgments groups covering the full appeal chain for the subject case. Fetched from HKLII's /api/getappealhistory and saved as {stem}.appeal_history.json. Typically 1-4 entries — 99.1% of 162,373 files fall in that range; observed max is 43 entries; zero empty arrays in the current corpus (schema still allows [] since there is no minItems constraint).

act.description: Docket code for this rung of the chain (e.g. 'FAMV5/2013', 'CACV254/2011'). See parser.COURT_PREFIX_MAP for the act-prefix → court-slug lookup.

judgments.description: Judgments issued on this docket, chronological (oldest first).

remarks.description: HKLII remarks field. Often empty; occasionally 'reversed', 'affirmed', etc.

path.description: HKLII URL path of the judgment.

lang.description: Language of the judgment record. Uppercase in this endpoint's response (contrast with the lowercase `lang` used elsewhere).
